picks.title: Google's AI Agents Just Killed the Ender Dragon in Minecraft Without Any Help in What Is Believed to Be a World First
picks.excerpt: Google researchers have released a paper claiming that four Google Gemini 4 Argon AI agents just beat Minecraft without any help from humans. It took them just over 27 hours to take down the Ender Dragon in what is believed to be a world first.
picks.rationale: New research release: multi-agent Gemini team finishes Minecraft unaided in ~27h, a concrete benchmark for agentic play and automated playtesting.

picks.title: Adam Boyes' Vivrato issues report based on 101 game leaders' views on AI in gaming
picks.excerpt: Vivrato, a games industry consultancy headed by Adam Boyes, released the Vivrato AI Adoption (VAIA) Report 2026, saying AI is being used widely in game production but in a fairly shallow way so far.
picks.rationale: Fresh data release (VAIA Report 2026, 101 leaders) showing AI is widespread but shallow in production; benchmark for studio planning.

picks.title: [이슈] 'AI 카피캣' 우려에 국내 인디 스푸키친 데모 닫았다
picks.excerpt: 최근 출시를 앞둔 인디 게임들이 AI를 이용한 복제작이 먼저 등장할 가능성을 우려해 공개 데모 배포를 취소하는 사례가 보고되고 있는 가운데, 국내에서도 그런 사례가 나왔다. 국내 2인 개발팀 YNOT은 지난 17일, 누군가 AI로 자신들의 게임 '스푸키친'을 베껴서 만들고 있다는 연락을 받고 공개 데모 배포를 중단하겠다고 예고했다. 그리고 오늘(20일) 데
picks.rationale: The single pick for the AI-copycat theme: first Korean case of an indie team pulling its public demo over AI cloning, a new concrete event distinct from the 10-17 Kotaku case.

picks.title: New launcher for viral AI mash-ups of Elden Ring, Minecraft, and more emerges – with some very questionable terms of service, should you value your PC
picks.excerpt: Those viral Elden Ring and Minecraft mashups you've likely seen circulating the web over the past couple of weeks are now conveniently available through a dedicated launcher, with terms of service that raise questions for anyone who values their PC.
picks.rationale: Follow-up with a new release: the vibe-coded mash-up mods now ship through a dedicated launcher whose ToS raise security concerns.

picks.title: The AI state of play: AI laws and game development
picks.excerpt: A run through of key areas in which the changing AI legal landscape is affecting game studios, from acting to advertising
picks.rationale: Actionable legal map for studios (performance rights to advertising rules) as AI laws shift; useful companion to recent union and compliance news.

https://www.gamesradar.com/games/new-lau.new_action: Release of a dedicated launcher distributing the viral AI mash-up games, with new terms of service
